title: Separate MiniMax H3 open-weight deployment from hosted service entitlement and billing admission
decisions: MiniMax H3 open-weight/local H3-Base deployment and MiniMax Open Platform hosted execution are separate admission domains.
The MiniMax H3 Community License governs the local/open-weight deployment path; hosted Open Platform service terms and billing entitlements are evaluated separately.
A Token Plan Subscription Key and standard pay-as-you-go API Key are distinct credential classes and MUST NOT be treated as interchangeable.

Commercial plan, Team subscription, model eligibility, quota, balance, rate limit and concurrency availability MUST be discovered at admission time and MUST NOT be hard-coded as a durable FA3 capability.
A historical or non-authoritative report about plan discontinuation MUST NOT become canonical service state when current official service surfaces do not establish it.
Automatic subscription-to-PAYG or PAYG-to-subscription fallback is forbidden; any billing/credential-class transition requires explicit FA3 policy plus an admitted secret of the target class.
For production hosted execution, PAYG or an explicitly admitted enterprise arrangement is preferred when applicable; a Token Plan is not a mandatory production dependency.
Hosted service prices are volatile provider metadata and MUST NOT be encoded as canonical contract constants.
